categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in high-end special steel materials and high-end equipment components, focusing on gear steel, mold steel, special alloys, and special stainless steel. It also produces new energy wind power components, energy equipment components, and other precision mechanical parts. The business is segmented into four main production bases specializing in materials R&D and smelting, precision machining of gearbox components, wind power castings and forgings, and energy power equipment cast steel and turbine blades.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced smelting, casting, forging, heat treatment, and precision machining technologies. It has developed proprietary processes such as vacuum melting, electroslag remelting, and digital twin-based manufacturing. Key innovations include high-purity alloy production, large-scale wind power casting, and specialized heat treatment techniques. The company holds over 214 patents, including 107 invention patents, and continuously invests in R&D to improve product quality and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large equipment manufacturers in new energy wind power, energy equipment, rail transit, mechanical equipment, military, aerospace, nuclear power, and marine petrochemical industries. The new energy wind power sector accounts for approximately 55.8% of revenue. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including major global players like Siemens and ZF, and has established a strong presence in Europe and China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangsu (Zhangjiagang and Rugao) and Sichuan (Deyang). It serves domestic markets extensively and exports to Europe and other regions. Sales are concentrated in East China, Southwest China, and overseas markets, with growing international sales accounting for about 4.48% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the upstream to downstream spectrum of the special steel and equipment components supply chain. It controls core processes including smelting, casting, forging, heat treatment, and precision machining, enabling full-process integration and supply chain control. It positions itself as a key supplier of both raw special steel materials and finished precision components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-end alloy materials production, enhancing wind power gearbox component manufacturing, and developing nuclear fusion-related materials. The company focuses on technological innovation, product quality improvement, cost reduction, and expanding product applications in military, aerospace, and energy sectors. R&D efforts emphasize new material development, process optimization, digital manufacturing, and intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-end special steel materials and precision equipment components to end customers. The company employs an order-driven production model with direct sales to large equipment manufacturers and steel stockists. It does not use distributors or agents, ensuring direct customer relationships and control over pricing and delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In special steel materials, the company competes with large state-owned groups like CITIC Special Steel, Dongbei Special Steel, and Baosteel Special Steel, as well as specialized private enterprises. It holds a competitive niche in high-technical-demand wind power materials and components. In wind power castings, it is among the leading domestic manufacturers with advantages in technology and scale, competing with large state-owned and private enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 4.0 billion, a 5.67% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 114.64 million, up 4.97%. Total assets reached RMB 11.46 billion, growing 7.54%. The company maintains steady growth with improving profitability and increased R&D investment, reflecting a stable and expanding financial profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated full-process manufacturing capability, from smelting to precision machining, ensuring high product quality, stability, and customization. It offers advanced materials with superior purity, mechanical properties, and reliability tailored for demanding applications in wind power, aerospace, and nuclear sectors. Its strong R&D and patent portfolio, combined with flexible production and cost control, provide differentiated value and competitive advantage.
